bullets.id: Emas menutup Oktober di level terlemah setahun. Financefeeds mencatat spot ditutup Jumat di $3.875,19 dan kontrak Desember COMEX di $3.898,90, turun 3,3%. Dalam sepekan emas turun 3,7% dan sepanjang Oktober sekitar 7,2%, penurunan bulanan kedua berturut-turut. Pasar tutup di akhir pekan, jadi harga ini menjadi titik awal Senin.
bullets.en: Gold closed October at a one-year low. Financefeeds has spot closing Friday at $3,875.19 and December COMEX futures at $3,898.90, down 3.3%. Gold fell 3.7% on the week and about 7.2% in October, a second straight monthly decline. Markets are shut over the weekend, so this is Monday’s starting point.

bullets.id: Tekanan datang dari taruhan kenaikan bunga: Fed menahan bunga di 3,75%–4,00% dengan dua pejabat meminta kenaikan, PCE September 3,6% yoy, dan Polymarket memberi peluang 70% kenaikan lagi tahun ini. Yield 10 tahun AS 4,93%, sementara S&P 500 turun 1,82% dan Nasdaq 2,86% pada Jumat. Menurut Trading Economics, emas sekitar 30,9% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dari Januari.
bullets.en: The pressure comes from rate-hike bets: the Fed held at 3.75%–4.00% with two officials calling for a hike, September PCE ran at 3.6% y/y, and Polymarket puts the odds of another hike this year at 70%. The US 10-year yield is 4.93%, while the S&P 500 fell 1.82% and the Nasdaq 2.86% on Friday. Per Trading Economics, gold is about 30.9% below its $5,608.35 January record.

bullets.id: Level yang dipantau: support $3.800, sekitar 1,9% di bawah penutupan, dan resistance $4.000, sekitar 3,2% di atas; skenario dasar Financefeeds $3.840–3.950. Survei Kitco: 10 dari 16 analis (63%) memperkirakan emas turun, dengan target $3.750–3.850. Agenda pekan ini: ISM manufaktur Senin, pemilu sela AS dan JOLTS Selasa, ADP dan ISM jasa Rabu, Bank of England Kamis, dan payroll Oktober Jumat.
bullets.en: Levels in focus: support at $3,800, about 1.9% below the close, and resistance at $4,000, about 3.2% above; Financefeeds’ base case is $3,840–3,950. Kitco’s survey: 10 of 16 analysts (63%) expect lower gold, with targets of $3,750–3,850. This week: ISM manufacturing Monday, the US midterms and JOLTS Tuesday, ADP and ISM services Wednesday, the Bank of England Thursday, and October payrolls Friday.

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram masih Rp2.526.000 dengan buyback Rp2.276.000 (spread sekitar 9,9%), karena Logam Mulia belum memperbarui harga pada Minggu. Galeri24 turun Rp35.000 ke Rp2.443.000 (buyback Rp2.299.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS turun Rp34.000 ke Rp2.467.000 (buyback Rp2.274.000, spread sekitar 7,8%). Secara struktural, ETF emas global masih memegang rekor 4.256 ton.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price stays at Rp2,526,000 with a Rp2,276,000 buyback (spread about 9.9%), as Logam Mulia has not updated prices on Sunday. Galeri24 fell Rp35,000 to Rp2,443,000 (buyback Rp2,299,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS fell Rp34,000 to Rp2,467,000 (buyback Rp2,274,000, spread about 7.8%). Structurally, global gold ETFs still hold a record 4,256 tonnes.
